profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Collaborative, UX-driven, full-stack Web technologist. Passionate about rapid, sustainable development,  flexible teams, lean processes, and short feedback loops. I evolve maintainable systems while mentoring people and building teams.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Tech Lead
positions.description:
Greenfield UI refresh, API and platform work, and SOA breakup of legacy monolith. Team lead.

Front-end work in React, Ember, Twitter Flight, and Backbone. Back-end work in various Ruby frameworks (Rails, Sinatra, Hanami).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed an app (now, data-axle.com) for intuitively querying business data with Elasticsearch to generate insights. Built with Backbone and Rails, tests in Jasmine and RSpec, deployment on AWS and Heroku. Worked with Pivotal to apply various agile and XP techniques (100% pairing, BDD, Kanban, 12-factor).

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Created a Web venue for live events allowing users to view, collect, and share art. Built a client-facing suite of tools to manage data, assets, communications, and commerce. Developed in PHP, Javascript, jQuery, HTML, and CSS/SASS.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Worked with various design studios and marketing firms to develop interactive marketing content, apps, and games in Adobe Flash.

• Transistor Studios [transistorstudios.com]
Projects included mini-games for Nintendo’s “Donkey Kong Country Returns” campaign, apps for Pepsi’s Propel Water homepage, and interactive 3D content for Lenovo’s “Anthem” campaign.

• Grey Group [grey.com]
Clients: Canon, Lilly

• Agile Partners [agilepartners.com]
Client: Citigroup, Smith Barney

educations.fieldOfStudy: BA, BA, Computer Science, Media Theory, Philosophy
